sections.section_title: Absolute Grounds for Refusal of Registration
sections.content: Section 9(1)(b): Trade marks which consist exclusively of marks or indications which may serve in trade to designate the kind, quality, quantity, intended purpose, values, geographical origin or time of production of goods shall not be registered.

sections.section_title: Prohibition of Registration of Names of Chemical Elements or International Non-Proprietary Names
sections.content: Section 13: No word which is the commonly used and accepted name of any single chemical element or single chemical compound or generic botanical term shall be registered as a trade mark.
